a_emptyTriple.hint: --adapter ocap needs the chain triple (network/chainHost/tokenId): network is missing; chainHost is missing; tokenId is missing. Set ARCBLOG_CHAIN_ENV=beta|main to fill the defaults, or pass --network / --chain-host / --token-id (or the matching ARCBLOG_CHAIN_* env) explicitly — see docs/operations-runbook.md "Chain environment".

conflict.message: ARCBLOG_CHAIN_ENV=beta conflicts with config/roles.json (network=arcblock): pass the value explicitly (--network / ARCBLOG_CHAIN_NETWORK) or re-run node scripts/arcblog-roles.mjs init --network beta

missingMnemonic.message: the real chain adapter needs the ARC libraries and a funded wallet: missing ARCBLOG_CHAIN_MNEMONIC (factory owner mnemonic). Install them (npm i @ocap/client @ocap/wallet @arcblock/did-ext bip39) and set ARCBLOG_CHAIN_HOST / ARCBLOG_CHAIN_TOKEN_ID / ARCBLOG_CHAIN_MNEMONIC, or use --adapter mock for
